charts.question: How does the recommended platform fee progress across public plans?

blocks.body:
## Executive Summary

- **Adopt platform + operating-seat + location + bounded usage.** It gives UAE customers a predictable AED subscription while charging for the drivers that scale cost and value.
- **Launch at AED 499 / 1,299 / 2,999 per month, before VAT.** Annual prepayment receives a 20% effective discount; Enterprise starts with a AED 6,000/month annual floor.
- **Resolve the SAM-18 numeric conflict explicitly.** This delegated commercial baseline replaces SAM-18 §5's 5 / 20 / 50+ included paid seats with 3 / 10 / 25 and the listed one-seat add-ons, while preserving SAM-18's role, deterministic seat-counting, hard-limit and organization-isolation principles. SAM-19 remains the organization/membership data-model source of truth.
- **Do not claim live billing, entitlement or compliance capability.** SAM-18 and SAM-19 both describe pending implementation/design, and the supplied retail handoff calls subscription/usage billing a target.
- **Avoid GMV/payment fees at launch.** NewMe is not yet positioned as broker- or merchant-of-record; use transparent lead/order and AI limits instead.

## SAM-18 / SAM-19 governance

Canonical `81ac9fcf00696a6e1b6e026f69662e49ec2f6015` contains SAM-18 (blob `94a45599582885507ad789d190f237230fc57a60`) and SAM-19 (blob `f6d968456fa82034afca2679d012feaa9bec4560`). This record governs commercial prices, included 3 / 10 / 25 operating seats, one-seat add-ons, one base organization, and the second-industry add-on. An operating seat still means an accepted, active organization membership with a SAM-18 billable role; multiple paid roles in one organization count once, while memberships in two organizations count separately. Every organization has one primary industry, and the second-industry add-on provisions a second isolated organization. SAM-19 continues to govern organization, membership, role-link, authorization, audit and migration design. None of these records proves deployed functionality.

## A clear four-tier price card

Prices are tax-exclusive. An operating seat is the commercial name for a SAM-18 paid seat: an accepted, active organization membership holding at least one billable organization role. Multiple paid roles in one organization count once; the same person in two organizations counts once in each. Read-only and narrowly scoped external users remain free only when server-side authorization enforces their restrictions.

The price steps are designed to make Growth the normal team adoption tier and Scale the multi-location operating tier; Enterprise remains negotiated because its support, security and integration commitments create materially different cost-to-serve.

## One platform, two industry packages

**Brokerage:** lead routing, listings, documents/media readiness, viewings/offers/deals, approval and commission/payroll controls. **Retail:** catalog/inventory, discount approvals, quotations, transfer/replenishment, delivery/COD and finance controls. The platform layer is tenant separation, roles, audit, workflows, reports and VAT-aware fields. A base subscription includes one organization with one primary package; the second-package add-on provisions a second isolated organization rather than mixing both industries inside one organization.

## Usage, implementation and recovery policy

Extra operating seats cost AED 149 / 129 / 109 and must be explicitly purchased before activation or restoration above the included limit; there is no silent seat overage. Extra locations cost AED 199 / 179 / 149; AI credits AED 0.12 / 0.10 / 0.08; brokerage qualified leads AED 0.50 / 0.40 / 0.30; retail completed orders AED 0.12 / 0.10 / 0.08. Default AI behavior is a hard cap, not surprise billing. Offer a 14-day controlled trial; price-protect annual platform fees to a maximum 10% renewal increase with 60 days' notice. At 14 days overdue, tenant access becomes read-only; at 30 days it is suspended with a 90-day retention window proposed, subject to legal review.

## What three typical customers would pay

These examples make the meters saleable and auditable. The VAT values are illustrative rather than tax advice.

## Provisional margin guardrails

No NewMe cost-to-serve data was available. Using a provisional AI-cost range of AED 0.025–0.075 per credit, the Scale AED 0.08 AI overage can fall to only 6.25% contribution before support at the high case. Contract approval should require at least 70% modeled recurring gross margin at base cost and 55% at high-cost sensitivity; high-touch migration and integrations must be paid onboarding, not hidden in MRR.

## Market evidence supports hybrid packaging

Official pages reviewed on July 30, 2026 show established combinations of tiers, paid seats, free viewers or external users, AI/usage credits, location/POS add-ons, per-transaction charges, onboarding and custom enterprise terms. Their currencies, geographies, tax treatment and feature limits are not directly comparable, so the evidence guides model design rather than a converted price benchmark.

## UAE launch requirements

Show AED prices before VAT and add the applicable VAT line. Build structured-invoice data and an eInvoicing integration boundary, but do not claim accreditation. PDPL requires privacy/security and controlled processing; DLD Trakheesi verification supports an evidence-driven brokerage publication gate. These are product requirements, not legal advice; VAT applicability, eInvoicing milestones, PDPL duties and DLD workflow claims require current authoritative review before contract or launch.

## SAM-29 — retail requirements and industry boundary

Acceptance is independent from lifecycle operations: prove that the Retail package is isolated from Brokerage, company/branch/location scopes cannot cross tenants, completed-order usage excludes cancelled/test/duplicate/replayed events, and retail role/financial controls remain enforced through plan changes. Required evidence is the entitlement test, tenant/location negative tests, role/field fixtures, and order-meter replay/classification tests.

## SAM-30 — provisioning, seats, suspension and exit

Acceptance follows SAM-29 and requires a separate lifecycle run: provision a verified administrator and contracted package; enforce named operating, read-only, external and service-account rules; emit auditable usage and invoice lines; transition overdue tenants through notices, read-only and suspension; restore without losing audit evidence; and exercise authorized export plus retention/deletion simulation without production data.

## Recommended next steps

1. Use this delegated price card and its precedence rules as the commercial baseline while repository acceptance and implementation remain pending.
2. Add a tenant entitlement and immutable usage ledger before selling usage-based terms.
3. Turn the six acceptance areas in the decision record into Linear acceptance criteria without changing any current Linear status.
4. Re-price AI and implementation after 30 days of measured pilot cost-to-serve.

## Caveats and assumptions

This is a delegated commercial baseline, not a deployed feature list or legal/tax advice. SAM-18 and SAM-19 remain pending implementation/design records; this artifact changes only the explicitly identified commercial values and does not establish live schema, RLS, billing, entitlement or compliance capability. It relies on user-provided source ZIPs and public pages captured July 30, 2026. Current vendor prices, VAT applicability, eInvoicing milestones and regulatory obligations must be verified at contract signature.
